source_support.mechanism: The RPC executor is a process-local static lazy thread pool; its size comes from num_server_call_thread. RayConfig initializes the setting from RAY_num_server_call_thread, and an explicit system config can override it.

inferences.direct_cause: OS refused a Ray RPC-executor thread creation with EAGAIN. Lazy executor creation on GC is the immediate failure path.
inferences.direct_cause_confidence: high: actual fatal native stack names and error match upstream 2.40 code
inferences.large_per_process_default_rpc_pool_is_co: strongly plausible given many idle workers and hardware-concurrency-based default; per-process actual default thread count was not directly measured
inferences.tasks_max_4096_exhaustion: possible but not proven; no valid own cgroup pids.events/max/current at failure in the raw snapshot
alternative_eagain_sources: memory or address-space/stack resources needed for new threads

minimal_recovery_setting.apply_before: Create only the new owned recovery process/Ray head, before importing/initializing Ray, and inherit in all Ray workers.
minimal_recovery_setting.change_scope: Ray infrastructure only; no loss, hyperparameter, model, split, GPU count or node changes.
minimal_recovery_setting.tasks_max_adjustment: Do not attribute failure to TasksMax or enlarge it solely from the invalid raw root cgroup. Raise the new recovery unit limit only if genuine owned/ancestor PID evidence supports needed headroom.
minimal_recovery_setting.verification_not_a_new_gate: Mainline records actual new-unit configured setting/thread/PID measurements during the already authorized native5 recovery; this diagnosis adds no review or test loop.

metadata_watcher: Existing watcher exited after genuine training terminal; preserve its unit and archive history.
